## Functional acceptance

- [x] Visual QA at a 1,000 by 900 CSS-pixel viewport confirmed that the full product
      name wraps inside the control header and **Clear** remains wholly contained in
      the sidebar rather than overlapping the plot.
- [x] Automated layout checks cover 1,550, 1,200, 761, and 760 CSS-pixel viewport widths,
      including the desktop-to-stacked breakpoint, in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
- [x] Advanced options labels the matrix-dimension selector **Plot resolution** and
      presents a read-only **Plot window size** immediately below it.
- [x] A 24,000 bp fixture at 500 cells reports `48 bp per cell`, changes to `24 bp per
      cell` after one zoom level, and returns to `48 bp per cell` after reset.
- [x] Uneven partitions report the exact floor/ceiling range, terminal resolution
      reports `1 bp per cell`, and grid mode reports that the value varies until an
      individual plot is opened.

## Local toolchain note

On the macOS validation host, direct Wasm and one Rust test invocation required the
pinned Rust 1.98.0 toolchain binary and library paths to be supplied explicitly. The
plain child shell did not expose `rustc`, and the restricted Wasm build could not reach
its cached `wasm-bindgen` helper. Re-running with the pinned environment passed, so
these were local toolchain-environment constraints rather than source failures.
